turn.content: Both issues are quantity over-receipts. Records show only one receipt (5 licenses, 2 cable boxes) against PO quantities of 19 and 3, no earlier invoices on this PO, and contract clause KTR-V-017#7.2 permits partial delivery with the remainder billed after receipt. So this is an over-billing shortfall: goods invoiced beyond what was received, with no receipt covering the excess.
